title: Objective 2 not active after completion of Objective 1
body:
I'm not sure if this is a bug but, after setting up a new AAPS profile and competing all tasks for Objective 1 (each one displaying green text "Completed, well done!"), and hitting verify, a Please Wait dialogue flashes for a moment and goes away.  From that point it does not activate Objective 2 and there is no way to move on through the objectives.  Any ideas what could be wrong?

AAPS version 3.1.0.3 Build 1de236a602-2022.10.23-10:18 fullrelease

comments.body: This was not a bug. The issue was solved by adjusting the time on my phone to “update per network connection”
